newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-National Foods chief may go - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-National Foods chief may go - paper.

text.p: Executives at National Foods Ltd were not available on Tuesday morning to comment on a report in the Australian Financial Review newspaper that managing director Graham Reaney may be replaced as part of a boardroom reshuffle.
A company receptionist said the board was meeting this morning ahead of the release of the 1995/96 profit result this afternoon.

"Sources close to the company said that Mr Reaney could be replaced as early as today by a recently appointed director, Mr Max Ould, who is a former chief executive officer of Peters Foods," the newspaper said.
The newspaper also said the former chief executive of biscuit maker Arnotts Ltd, Paul Bourke, may be appointed to an executive position at National Foods.
It said the changes were being demanded by two key Asia-based investors, Singapore's Camerlin Pte Ltd and Hong Kong's Mingly Corp, which had the backing of institutional shareholders.

Camerlin had an 8.12 percent stake in National Foods, the paper said, while Mingly has a 10.4 percent interest and has regulatory permission to go to the takeover threshold of 19.9 percent. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
